newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore 1996 Q3 inflation averages 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore 1996 Q3 inflation averages 1.4 pct.

text.p: Singapore's Ministry of Trade and Industry said on Friday the country's consumer price index (CPI) measuring inflation rose 1.4 percent year-on-year in the third quarter of 1996.
The CPI for the third quarter of 1996 rose by 0.3 percent over the previous quarter.
The ministry said in a statement all price group indices increased except for clothing.
"Inflation remained low in the third quarter of 1996. External inflationary pressures were benign while domestic pressures were contained due to keen competition." the statement said.
